gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests how {@link Tag} treats tag-name case and how it derives a tag's local name.

ADDED i2: Tag look-up is case-insensitive: "script" and "SCRIPT" resolve to equivalent tags, regardless of the active locale.

Two ways of resolving a tag are exercised
ADDED i3: Via Tag.valueOf: differently cased names produce equal tags.
ADDED i4: Via a shared TagSet: differently cased names return the same cached instance.
ADDED i5: A tag's local name is its name without any namespace prefix: "img" has no prefix, while "bk:book" has local name "book".
